heading_en: Minimum Required Observation Period, etc. for EAD Estimation of Corporate, etc. Exposures
summary_ja: 事業法人等向けEAD推計の七年以上の観測期間、最長期間のデータ、デフォルト件数加重を定める。
summary_en: Requires an AIRB UDPC to use data covering at least seven years for corporate, etc. EAD, to use the longest period, and to use a default-count-weighted average.
paragraphs: In estimating the EAD of corporate, etc. exposures to which the advanced internal ratings-based approach may be applied, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the advanced internal ratings-based approach shall use one or more of external data, internal data, or data pooled among multiple financial institutions, covering an observation period of seven years or more.

In using each item of data referred to in the preceding paragraph, the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the advanced internal ratings-based approach shall include in its coverage the data covering the longest observation period; provided, however, that this does not apply to data of low relevance in estimating EAD.
In estimating EAD, the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the advanced internal ratings-based approach shall use a weighted average by number of defaults.
